Payout of 28 July is short ₹8,584.50.
The bank credited ₹3,06,939.36 against an expected ₹3,15,523.86. 23 orders sit in this payout. No refund, chargeback or payment in the gateway ledger accounts for the difference, so the cause is not yet identified.
Suggested action: request the gateway's own breakdown for this payout, and check for a dispute debited but not yet reported.
